5405 English Oak Drive
Killeen, TX 76542
$340,000, 5 bed, 3.50 bath, 2,785 SF, MLS# 575947

Worthy of your style! Well-maintained brick Ranch. There are many simple things that bring about inspiration, and you will be animated indeed with features such as covered back porch, fencing and city utilities. 5 bedrooms, 3 and 1/2 baths. Delight in the extravagance of the garden tub and dual vanities. The airy interior of this home offers a special backdrop for entertaining and decorating possibilities. Also to be considered: Spacious floorplan, high ceilings, master bath, separate shower, pantry, ceiling fans. Allows a brilliant lifestyle!

3 full bath, 1 half bath
